short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: I have to solve it AGAIN for every load?!
short_scenes.narration: Every time Volt changes the load, he has to solve the whole circuit again.
Thevenin says any circuit is just one voltage source and one resistor. Remove the load, measure nine volts, that's V Thevenin.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Seen from two terminals, even a huge circuit acts like one battery with one resistor. Find the open circuit voltage and the resistance once, and you're done.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Find two numbers once, and every load is a one line answer.
